late_blight.name: Late Blight (Phytophthora infestans)

severity_thresholds.HIGH: Relative Humidity > 90% and Temp between 12-21°C with continuous cloudiness/rain

late_blight.recommendation: High late blight risk detected. Spray Mancozeb 75 WP @ 2.5 g/L or Cymoxanil + Mancozeb @ 2 g/L during clear weather window. Ensure proper field drainage.
late_blight.organic_measure: Apply Trichoderma viride @ 5g/L or copper oxychloride preventive spray.

downy_mildew.name: Downy Mildew (Plasmopara viticola)

severity_thresholds.HIGH: Temp 18-24°C and RH > 85% with leaf wetness > 6 hours

downy_mildew.recommendation: Favorable conditions for Downy Mildew. Apply Potassium phosphonate @ 4 g/L or Dimethomorph @ 1 g/L. Spray only when wind < 12 km/h.
downy_mildew.organic_measure: Spray Bordeaux mixture 1% as prophylactic measure.

powdery_mildew.name: Powdery Mildew (Erysiphe / Leveillula)

severity_thresholds.HIGH: Warm dry days (25-30°C) followed by humid mornings (60-70% RH)

powdery_mildew.recommendation: Apply Wettable Sulphur 80 WDG @ 2-3 g/L or Hexaconazole 5 EC @ 1 ml/L during morning hours.
powdery_mildew.organic_measure: Foliar spray of 10% cow milk or neem seed kernel extract (NSKE 5%).

blast.name: Rice Blast (Magnaporthe oryzae)

severity_thresholds.HIGH: Night temperature 20-25°C with RH > 90% and morning dew

blast.recommendation: High blast risk for paddy. Apply Tricyclazole 75 WP @ 0.6 g/L or Isoprothiolane 40 EC @ 1.5 ml/L. Avoid excess nitrogen top-dressing.
blast.organic_measure: Spray Pseudomonas fluorescens @ 10g/L or fermented butter-milk solution.

pink_bollworm.name: Pink Bollworm & Whitefly

severity_thresholds.HIGH: Extended warm spell (30-36°C) and cloudy intervals triggering moth emergence

pink_bollworm.recommendation: Install 5 pheromone traps/acre for monitoring. If ETL (>8 moths/trap/night) crossed, apply Profenofos 50 EC @ 2 ml/L or Emamectin Benzoate 5 SG @ 0.4 g/L.
pink_bollworm.organic_measure: Release Trichogramma egg parasitoids @ 60,000/acre; spray 5% NSKE.

fall_armyworm.name: Fall Armyworm (Spodoptera frugiperda)

severity_thresholds.HIGH: Knee-high to whorl stage with warm temperatures (26-32°C)
severity_thresholds.MODERATE: Mild infestation during early vegetative stage

fall_armyworm.recommendation: Scout maize whorls for pin-hole feeding. Apply Chlorantraniliprole 18.5 SC @ 0.4 ml/L or Spinetoram 11.7 SC @ 0.5 ml/L into plant whorls.
fall_armyworm.organic_measure: Apply Bacillus thuringiensis (Bt) @ 2g/L or Beauveria bassiana @ 5g/L.

thrips_purple_blotch.name: Thrips & Purple Blotch (Alternaria porri)

severity_thresholds.HIGH: Rain followed by warm sunny days (Temp 24-30°C, RH > 80%)
severity_thresholds.MODERATE: Dry hot weather favoring thrips multiplication

thrips_purple_blotch.recommendation: Purple blotch risk elevated. Spray Tebuconazole 25.9 EC @ 1 ml/L + Fipronil 5 SC @ 1.5 ml/L with spreader sticker.
thrips_purple_blotch.organic_measure: Install blue sticky traps (20/acre) and spray Lecanicillium lecanii @ 5g/L.
